mapper.sql: a.sys13_code_group_id AS code_group_id, a.sys13_kind_group_cd AS kind_group_cd, a.sys13_kind_group_nm AS kind_group_nm, a.sys13_code_kind_id AS code_kind_id, a.sys13_code_id AS code_id, a.sys13_note AS note
mapper.select: SELECT , COALESCE(b.sys09_code, '') AS code, COALESCE(b.sys09_name, '') AS name FROM sys13_code_group a LEFT OUTER JOIN sys09_code b ON a.sys13_code_id = b.sys09_code_id WHERE sys13_code_group_id = #{codeGroupId}
SELECT , NULL AS code, NULL AS name FROM sys13_code_group a WHERE sys13_code_kind_id = #{codeKindId} AND sys13_code_id = 0 ORDER BY sys13_kind_group_cd, sys13_kind_group_nm
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys13_code_group (sys13_code_group_id, sys13_kind_group_cd, sys13_kind_group_nm, sys13_code_kind_id, sys13_code_id, sys13_note) VALUES (#{codeGroupId}, #{kindGroupCd}, #{kindGroupNm}, #{codeKindId}, #{codeId}, #{note})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM sys13_code_group WHERE sys13_code_group_id IN #{id}
